title: Duke asks him for ideas, and 'Mood Indigo' appears
summary: Coming home at dawn, Holmes was asked by Ellington for numbers to record; Carney later told him they had recorded 'Mood Indigo'.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, tell me the story about when you walked in and Duke asked you... You walked in like three in the morning.

Well, walkin' in at three, four, five and six o'clock in the morning, that was my usual hours coming in. Because I'd be hangin' out with the boys. That's when things happened, after the job at night. At two or three or four or five in the morning, that's when things' happened.

So I would be out all night, and I'd come in, come in the house, and Duke would be sitting up there, his paper and pencil. He says to me, 'Charlie, I have a recording date tomorrow, and I don't have anything to record -- any

numbers. You got any ideas on anything." I says, "What? Not this mornin'. I don't have any ideas on nothin' now but to get to bed." So he laughed. He shook his head, and said, "Well, I don't know what I'm going to do." He had this date to do, and... "I'll play something." So I went to bed, and that was it.

Well, a few days later, Harry told me, he said that date we had the other day, he says, "Man, one of them numbers we recorded sure was beautiful." He said, "It was so different. There was a trombone, trumpet and clarinet in the low register," and he explained to me the voicings. He said, "The three of us was at the microphone." He said, "It was beautiful." I said, "Yeah?" He said, "Yeah, it was 'Mood Indigo.'" That was the number he was telling me about. They had recorded that number... Duke didn't have anything to play... Now, where did this "Mood Indigo" come from, all of a sudden.
Obviously after you'd gone to bed.
Well, either that or when they got in the studio. Because he used to make up a lot of numbers in the studio, and ideas would come to him for different lines(?) or something like that. Yeah...
